items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: I was in Texas, livin'. with my wife, my first wife, Louella Brown, for ten...for seventeen years

ctx.x: After we played all those different towns in Florida, I went back to Louisiana...New Orleans, and I was in Texas, livin'. with my wife, my first wife, Louella Brown, for ten...for seventeen years, so I [ ] this guy...she said I wouldn't come home often
